title: Is Instinct safe to use? Three things to know before you sign up

reading.body:
Instinct is an AI personal assistant that collects personal information for model training by default, requiring users to opt out rather than opt in. The system can access and retain data from connected accounts even after those accounts are disconnected. It can make purchases on users' behalf, with disputes between users and merchants rather than handled by Instinct itself. This deployment model creates exposure of sensitive data including browsing habits, location, health details, and financial information.

The failure mode is a system deployed with data practices that transfer privacy risks to users without clear consent mechanisms. A human review of data handling before launch could have caught the difference between opt-out and opt-in consent structures. What is not established: whether Instinct's practices violate any regulation, whether users actually experienced harm, or whether the characterization of these practices as risks is disputed by Instinct.

summary:
# Summary

Instinct is an AI personal assistant that has gained popularity in Silicon Valley, but it presents significant privacy and data security risks that users should understand before signing up. The service uses personal information to train AI models unless users opt out, can access and retain data from connected accounts even after disconnection, and can make purchases on users' behalf with potential disputes handled between the user and merchants rather than Instinct. Users may unknowingly share sensitive information like browsing habits, location data, health details, and financial information that could be used for AI training purposes.

Norton argues that users should not sacrifice their privacy to use AI assistants and presents Norton Family Assistant as an alternative that prioritizes data protection. Unlike Instinct, Norton Family Assistant does not use shared information to train AI models, requires explicit user confirmation before taking actions like submitting forms or booking appointments, and allows users to easily delete their data. Norton emphasizes that advanced AI capabilities can be helpful while still protecting users' personal information and security.
